_readme: Developer-managed default links for the CLIENT portal Links page (/portal/reports).
Not editable from the UI — this file is the only place these are defined.
Add an entry under a role and it appears for those users on their next visit
to the Links page. Entries under ALL go to every client role.
color  optional — blue | green | red | amber | purple | pink | cyan (default blue)
key    optional — a stable id, defaults to a slug of the name. Set it if you
want to rename a link later without it re-seeding as a second copy.
Once a link reaches a user it belongs to them: their edits and deletes stick,
and it is never re-added. Changing a name or url here does NOT update users
who already have that link — it only affects users who haven't received it yet.
Entries missing a name or url are skipped and logged; a malformed file is
logged and ignored rather than breaking the page.
